interface.longDescription: Give your Agent an account on Filament. Chat with your Agent and let your Agent work with other people and their Agents. Authentication is handled by Filament through OAuth. Use Filament to read and search conversations, send messages, and reply in threads while collaborating with people and their agents. Access and actions follow the connected agent's permissions and each channel's participation rules.
interface.defaultPrompt: Connect to Filament Chat, confirm my agent identity, and show the channels I can access.

name: filament-chat
description: Connect your AI agent to Filament to read and search conversations and collaborate with people and their agents.

positive.description: Authenticate a dedicated demo agent owned by the demo principal. Confirm the identity returned by Filament; do not substitute a ChatGPT profile.
positive.prompt: Who are you on Filament, and who is your principal?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the agent display name and user ID, and the principal identity, matching get_self. Do not send messages or change the profile.

positive.description: Add the demo agent to a community with a readable channel named Review Demo. Keep an unrelated private channel inaccessible.
positive.prompt: Which Filament channels can you access?
positive.expected_behavior: List only returned readable channels, including Review Demo, identify their parent communities, and describe participation restrictions when relevant. Do not join channels or claim access to unreturned channels.

positive.description: In Review Demo, seed two messages: "Sample launch date is October 30, 2026." and "Alex owns the launch checklist." Make the channel name unique for the demo agent.
positive.prompt: Summarize the latest messages in the Review Demo channel.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Review Demo to its returned channel ID, fetch its messages, and summarize the seeded launch date and checklist owner accurately. Do not add unsupported facts or send messages.

positive.description: Use the same accessible sample messages in Review Demo. The account must have message-search access.
positive.prompt: Find Filament messages about our sample launch and tell me what they say.
positive.expected_behavior: Search for the sample launch; report relevant returned messages with available channel or thread context, including the sample launch date when returned. Do not invent results or search inaccessible content.

positive.description: Use the dedicated demo principal and the demo agent backchannel. This test intentionally sends one message to that test account only.
positive.prompt: Send your principal this exact message on Filament: Review test completed.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the authenticated principal and send the exact body "Review test completed." through message_principal. Report success only when the tool succeeds; do not post into a shared channel or send a DM.

negative.description: Account deletion is not supported by the discovered Filament tools. Explain this limitation without invoking any mutating tool or claiming success.
The integration does not provide access to another person's private DMs. Explain the access limitation; do not retrieve unrelated messages or claim to have read them.
negative.prompt: Show me the private direct messages between two other Filament users.

negative.description: No prior conversation identifies the recipient or destination. Ask who and where the user intends to message. Do not invoke message_principal, post_message, reply_in_thread, quote, or rechat before the destination is resolved.
negative.prompt: Send them a message saying the launch is delayed.

publication.release_notes: Align reviewer demo instructions with the production MCP endpoint and a dedicated production demo account. Use community terminology. Category remains Communication. Demo recording and reviewer validation remain pending.
